title: HTB: PingPong
caption: Two forests, one WriteDacl: the path from c.roberts to Administrator on both DCs.
description: PingPong is an Insane Windows AD box built around a cross-forest trust. ESC13 gives WinRM on DC1, which turns out to be dual-homed onto a second, internal forest. Taking over a group by ownership alone leaks a gMSA's credentials, a JEA command-visibility bypass leaks a plaintext password, and RBCD plus GodPotato gets SYSTEM on DC2. DCSync there hands over the real, unforged cross-forest bridge, an ESC4-to-ESC1 flip on a certificate template, and PKINIT finishes both domains.
